name: Bad Breath (Malboro)
doc: Bad Breath (Malboro's enemy attack): the master and the emitter - the breath's mesh from the caster's mouth, its sprites, one target task a target tinting it, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag131_bad_breath.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: The breath's mesh from the caster's mouth, its sprites, one target task a target tinting it, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of a target task

params.label: Target
params.doc: The prim-model layout target (its models' animation)

params.label: Bubble
params.doc: The sprite sequence bubble (a flipbook of 18 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Model 1 model
params.doc: The prim model model 1 (a mesh of 165 vertices, 120 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Model 2 model
params.doc: The prim model model 2 (a mesh of 165 vertices, 120 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Colours
params.doc: The colours it blends through (16 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Tint colour
params.doc: The colour the targets are tinted toward (4 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
